errors.evidence: The description states that the "дизел" (diesel) category is brown ("кафяво"), but the chart and legend clearly show it is represented by a light blue slice.

The description claims that the segments are ordered by size, but this is not true. The sequence of percentages around the pie chart (e.g., 12.70%, 34.40%, 14.40%, 29.50%) is not in ascending or descending order.
